10.08.26 - Ep.21 - The Intelligent Market Infrastructure Intelligent Market Infrastructure: Prediction, Reputation & Capital

Financial markets are evolving from simple transaction platforms into increasingly intelligent ecosystems driven by data, probabilities, artificial intelligence and blockchain technology.

In Episode 21 Part 1 of RIFT Before You Quit, we explore the rise of Intelligent Market Infrastructure and how prediction markets, capital management, reputation systems and AI-driven financial technology are beginning to converge.

The episode examines how markets are increasingly becoming probability engines, where participants continuously process information and express their expectations about future events.

In this episode:
- The evolution of financial markets from traditional trading to AI-driven infrastructure
- Why information is becoming a financial asset
- The difference between trading assets and trading probabilities
- How prediction markets aggregate information
- The concept of the Wisdom of Crowds
- How market-implied probabilities are created
- Why better information can lead to better capital allocation
- The growing importance of data, behavioural information and prediction accuracy
- How prediction markets are structured
- The importance of liquidity and market makers
- How order books create price discovery
- Why oracle systems are essential to blockchain-based prediction markets
- How real-world events can be verified and connected to blockchain settlement
- The different types of prediction markets, including binary, range and multi-outcome markets
- How RIFT's developing ecosystem connects trading, automation, Smart Money and prediction infrastructure

The episode also revisits an important objective of the RIFT Before You Quit series: developing more informed and confident traders by helping participants understand not only how to trade, but also how the financial infrastructure surrounding markets is changing.

The discussion concludes with the foundations of prediction-market architecture and sets up the next stage of the series, where we continue exploring how RIFT's prediction infrastructure fits into the future of intelligent financial markets.

Understand the market. Understand the infrastructure. Prepare for the future.

The Right Way to Hold Lag #golfswing #golftips Lag is crucial for compression, but holding the angle without managing the clubface creates big misses. To strike irons cleanly, you need to maintain lag and allow the face to square as you rotate through impact. Paying attention to both prevents shanks, toe strikes, and weak contact while keeping the handle leading. This is the blend that produces true ball-turf compression.

Stop Bending Your Knees Wrong The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

⛳ Start your range session with wedges, not the driver, to warm up properly.
🎯 Always pick a target for every practice shot.
🤝 Relax your grip for a smoother, more natural swing.
🏌️ Master the bump-and-run by using your putting technique with a wedge.
🌱 Learn why repairing pitch marks matters and the correct way to do it.

These are easy habits that will help you build better fundamentals and enjoy your golf even more.

videos.title: Geely EX5: Why pay double for a Porsche?
videos.summary_source_text:
Geely EX5: Why pay double for a Porsche? The Geely EX5 is certainly cheap, but is it better than what the leading German manufacturers have to offer? 

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Mat’s got his hands on the Geely EX5! 

It’s a luxurious-feeling, family-sized electric SUV that has class-leading German SUVs such as the Volkswagen ID4 and Audi Q4 e-tron in its sights! 

The question is, should you choose this all-new Chinese SUV over its more established rivals? Let’s take a closer look.. 

Starting with the design, it has a fairly inoffensive look and feel from the outside. The £800 paint on the model we’re reviewing certainly helps it stand out, but otherwise it’s relatively generic, with smooth curves across the bonnet. Around the side there’s black cladding around the wheel arches, satin roof bars and chrome window surrounds. Around the back, the design is again relatively nondescript, although we can’t help but see some Macan similarities! 

On the inside, the EX5 is very well kitted out. There are soft-touch materials throughout the cabin, and the £300 white trim option extra really helps to elevate it. There’s a huge infotainment screen which is crisp, sharp, and easy to use, and the digital dial screen offers all the information you need. The steering wheel is a bit of an odd shape, but it’s still ok to use, and there are some physical buttons to help adjust the climate control. All-in, it’s a well-made interior that feels luxurious. 

The Geely EX5 comes with a single motor and a 60.2kWh battery, which is good for a range of 267 miles. It has a power output of 218hp, and this power is sent to the front wheels only. 

The EX5 range starts from just £31,000, with the price rising to approximately £37,700 for the range-topping model we have here (at least, that’s the cost on Carwow at the time of filming). So the question is, would you choose this over one of the more-established, more-expensive rivals such as the Q4? Let us know in the comments!

videos.title: 477. Två år sedan FIRE som 50-åring | Uppföljning med Jesper i communityn
videos.summary_source_text:
477. Två år sedan FIRE som 50-åring | Uppföljning med Jesper i communityn Jesper slutade jobba vid 50. Två år senare är FIRE-kapitalet 5,7 miljoner kronor, trots två års uttag.

Han svarar på communityns frågor om uttagsstrategi, oro och vardagen utan lön, tredje uppföljningen i podden.

Kvartalsuttaget ligger på under en procent av kapitalet, med god marginal under fyraprocentsregeln. Portföljen är 94 procent aktier, huset obelånat, och på 24 månader har han bara behövt röra räntekontona en enda gång. Vi går igenom matten bakom FIRE, invändningarna mot en aggressiv portfölj och vad som faktiskt hände med identiteten när lönen försvann.

Then try this simple towel drill 👇

Grok 5 Is Coming: OpenAI Should Be Worried Link to our newsletter: https://bitbiased.ai/

Grok 5 could become one of the biggest and most ambitious AI models ever built — but how much of the hype is actually confirmed?

Reports and leaks point to a potential **6 trillion-parameter architecture**, a **1.5 million-token context window**, native **multi-agent capabilities**, enormous compute infrastructure, and increasingly bold AGI claims from Elon Musk.

But when you put the Grok 5 leaks, xAI’s compute story, shifting release timeline, and Musk’s public claims side by side, a much more complicated picture emerges.

In this video, I investigate what we actually know about **Grok 5**, what remains unconfirmed, and why the biggest number attached to the model may not be the most important part of the story.

We break down:
• The reported 6 trillion-parameter Grok 5 architecture
• Why Grok 5 parameter estimates keep changing
• The alleged Project Valis leak
• The reported 1.5 million-token context window
• Native dynamic multi-agent AI capabilities
• The Colossus compute story — and the surprising Anthropic connection
• Why Grok 5’s expected release timeline keeps shifting
• Elon Musk’s AGI probability claims
• The limitations missing from the hype
• What Grok 5 could mean for developers, businesses, and the AI race

The most important distinction: **reported specs and leaks are not the same as confirmed xAI disclosures.**

Right now, xAI has not published an official Grok 5 model card confirming the headline parameter count, context window, multi-agent architecture, benchmarks, pricing, or a firm public release date.

So is Grok 5 really shaping up to be a massive leap toward AGI — or are we watching expectations move faster than the evidence?

This breakdown separates **what’s reported, what’s leaked, what’s documented, and what remains speculation.**

videos.summary_source_text:
Millions Take This Blood Pressure Pill. Nobody Told Them About the Cough. Find out why Lisinopril gives you a cough and what to do about it. Learn why a Lisinopril cough isn’t caused by a problem with your lungs but by a buildup of certain chemicals in your airway.

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements. 

Lisinopril cough isn’t caused by a problem with your lungs, and there may be something that you can do about it. 

Lisinopril is an ACE inhibitor, meaning it blocks the ACE enzyme. This enzyme helps raise blood pressure and also clears away an irritating chemical that can build up in your throat.

ACE inhibitors are one of the most prescribed drugs in the world. Some people develop an ACE inhibitor cough, while others don’t. This may be related to zinc, a cofactor involved with the ACE enzyme. If you’re deficient in zinc, you’re more likely to develop an irritating cough. 

Research has shown that zinc can help relieve Lisinopril cough. 

The majority of hypertension is classified as essential, which means the cause is unknown. High blood pressure has been linked to high insulin, low potassium, and low magnesium. 

Alternatively, focus on lowering your blood pressure naturally to reduce the need for high blood pressure medication. Always check with your doctor before making changes to your prescribed medications.
